fill.Why are you interested in joining WRITER:
I'm applying for the Design Engineer (UK) role at WRITER because owning a design system as a product, for both the humans and the AI agents building with it, is the work I'm drawn to at the design-code seam.

I've spent about six years in product and interaction design. As an Interaction Designer at UKHSA on the NHS COVID-19 App, I worked within the GOV.UK Design System, where accessibility is built into every component rather than added afterwards. That's the standard you describe for WDS. On the build side, my project Fifteen is a TypeScript monorepo with a React 18 + Vite front end and an in-house design-system package. I built the design tokens, generated light/dark multi-theme stylesheets and per-theme typography, and the components that consume them. I also build agentic tools myself (a self-hosted LLM assistant with tool use, and a local Whisper + llama.cpp dictation tool), so making a design system legible to AI agents through .md skills and documentation is a problem I find genuinely interesting.

I'd bring a designer's eye for polish and a builder's sense of what keeps a system in sync across Figma, code and docs. I'm London-based, happy with hybrid working, and available immediately. I'd welcome the chance to talk about WDS.
